acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Application must run in a sealed environment like Docker with multiplatform compatibility (macOS, Windows, Android).
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: Tauri v2 configuration defines explicit ACL capabilities in `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json` restricting filesystem and process spawning, and sets Android 16KB page alignment.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Inspect tauri.conf.json and capabilities manifest; verify zero arbitrary shell execution permissions.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Real-time, performant ASCII rendering for images, videos, and 3D scenes.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: Engine initializes Tier 1 (WebGPU) if available, falling back to Tier 2 (WebGL2) or Tier 3 (Canvas 2D) without breaking frame output or crashing the UI thread.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Execute render loop in browser harness; simulate WebGPU absence; verify Canvas2D rasterizer generates valid ASCII matrix.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Port 3D procedural geometries (torus donut, sphere, cube, planet, blackhole) from Python core to interactive desktop/mobile UI.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User selects any of the 5 procedural scenes and sees real-time animated ASCII rendering with interactive rotation and lighting controls.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Cycle through all 5 demo presets; verify non-blank ASCII stream with active animation tick.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Convert images/videos into ASCII with adjustable contrast, brightness, charset ramps, and export capabilities.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User loads an image or video, tweaks parameters, views instant ASCII conversion, and exports result to .txt file, PNG, or system clipboard.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Load test bitmap; trigger export to text; assert generated string matches expected character ramp length.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Renderer must not crash on high-resolution inputs or rapid parameter scrubbing.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: 8K image upload is automatically clamped to 2048x2048 in worker without exceeding 100MB heap allocation; 120Hz slider scrubbing renders at capped 60 FPS without dropping UI frames.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Simulate STRESS-1 and STRESS-3 test vectors; monitor memory consumption and frame rate.
